version.description: Format version. Must be 1 for this schema.

tempoChanges.description: Mid-song tempo changes. Empty = constant tempo.

license.description: License of the published work (e.g. "Public Domain", "CC BY 4.0"). Empty = the file says nothing.

attribution.description: Attribution of the edition, including year and source URL when applicable. Travels with the file (CC-BY requires it). Empty = nothing to attribute.

TempoChange.description: A tempo change taking effect at the start of a measure, until the next one.

measureIndex.description: 0-indexed measure the new tempo starts at.

tempo.description: Tempo in BPM from that measure on.

tuning.description: String tuning from string 1 (highest) to string N (lowest).

capo.description: Capo position in frets (0 = none). Tab numbers stay relative to the capo; only the sounding pitch shifts up.

volume.description: Track volume in the mix, 0..1. An arrangement property like `capo`: imported from Guitar Pro, saved and exported. Absent means 1 (full scale).

instrument.description: Timbre of the track, or null/absent = unspecified. Deliberately narrow: it lists only what a player can actually render. Absent is NOT "guitar" — it means the file says nothing, and a player should fall back to its own sound preference. May grow within v1: a reader treats a value it cannot name as unspecified, keeps it aside and writes it back unchanged.

id.description: Stable identity of the measure's column: measure i of every track carries the same id, and no two columns share one. Absent in every file written before 2026-09-29; a reader then assigns p1..pN by position (measure n gets pn). Opaque: a reader never derives meaning from its content.

Beat.description: A rhythmic position in a measure. Empty notes = rest.

tuplet.description: Tuplet the beat belongs to. Absent or null = none.

Tuplet.description: count beats in the time of inTimeOf beats of the same written value (triplet = 3 in 2).

inTimeOf.description: Beats of the same written value the group replaces.

TabNote.description: A single note at a (string, fret) position.

techniques.description: Playing techniques attached to the note.

bendSemitones.description: Bend amplitude in semitones; meaningful only when techniques include BEND.

voice.description: Explicitly assigned voice. Absent or null = automatic (derived from register).

tied.description: Tied to the previous note on the same string: not attacked again, prolongs it.

TabVoice.description: Voice of a note. A = lower voice, B = upper voice. null = automatic. May grow within v1: a reader treats a value it cannot name as automatic, keeps it aside and writes it back unchanged.

TabTechnique.description: Playing technique. HAMMER_PULL and SLIDE are transitions toward the next note on the same string. May grow within v1: a reader keeps an element it cannot name aside and writes it back unchanged.

Duration.description: Musical note value. Quarter-note counts: WHOLE=4, HALF=2, QUARTER=1, EIGHTH=0.5, SIXTEENTH=0.25, THIRTY_SECOND=0.125. Closed for v1: a reader refuses a value it cannot name rather than guess the rhythm, so adding one bumps the version.

note.description: Pitch class. 's' suffix = sharp (e.g. Cs = C#). Closed for v1: a reader refuses a value it cannot name rather than guess the tuning, so adding one bumps the version.

octave.description: Octave number in scientific pitch notation. Middle C = {note: C, octave: 4}.
